Home.intro: I build knowledge graphs, ontologies, and data pipelines that run on high-performance computing. I’m a final-year computer science student at Chiang Mai University, currently applying machine learning to galactic archaeology.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.intro: Research software, tools, and systems — from formal ontologies to astronomy viewers.

onto-phsrs.title: Ontology-Augmented Health Recommendation
onto-phsrs.summary: A semantic recommendation system for Thai public health services. An OWL-DL ontology with 85 classes and 411 individuals, integrated with SWRL reasoning and a SPARQL query interface.
onto-phsrs.outcome: Matches user health profiles to service capabilities through explicit logic rather than keyword search — validated against every competency question with 38 SWRL rules and 40 SPARQL queries.

knowledge-graph-jaist.title: Knowledge Graphs from Unstructured Data
knowledge-graph-jaist.summary: A pipeline that constructs knowledge graphs from unstructured sources to support safety testing of autonomous driving systems, processing large datasets on the KAGAYAKI HPC cluster.
knowledge-graph-jaist.outcome: Presented at the JAIST Research Program 2025; automated semantic parsing reduced manual test-case generation.

galaxy-figure-archive.title: M81 / M82 Research Figure Archive
galaxy-figure-archive.summary: An archive for resolved-stellar-population analyses of M81 and M82 — density models, background estimates, substructure detections, and validation figures, each with full axes, legends, and provenance.
galaxy-figure-archive.outcome: Brought the analysis record together into one searchable, stage-aware archive with source links and side-by-side figure comparison.

fits-viewer.title: FITS Astronomy Data Viewer
fits-viewer.summary: An in-browser viewer for FITS files. A Canvas renderer displays CCD imagery and star catalogues of thousands of points without leaving the browser.
fits-viewer.outcome: A client-side FITS parser with optimised coordinate mapping for high-dimensional sky data.

graph-explorer.title: Knowledge Graph Explorer
graph-explorer.summary: A graph explorer that maps dependencies between academic papers and technical specifications using D3 force simulations over PostgreSQL.
graph-explorer.outcome: Real-time adjacency views and relational analysis across research datasets.

auto-grader.title: Automated Grading System
auto-grader.summary: Backend for a departmental grading system: Docker sandboxes execute submissions and the GPT-3.5 API generates feedback on code quality.
auto-grader.outcome: Served 80+ students per course and cut processing time by 80% while keeping feedback consistent.

word-games.title: Word Games
word-games.summary: Client-side solvers for Boggle and Spelling Bee built on prefix trees and backtracking search, backed by a cascading dictionary resolver.
word-games.outcome: Instant, in-browser validation using Trie lookups and depth-first search.

kiwis.title: Kiwis — Course Handbook
kiwis.summary: A documentation hub for systems programming courses, with Makefile-driven builds that generate and publish software setup guides.
kiwis.outcome: Used by 100+ students across 5 courses; standardised the assembly programming environment.

narit.org: National Astronomical Research Institute of Thailand (NARIT)

jaist.org: Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (JAIST)
points: Conducted computational research on knowledge graph construction from unstructured data using Python-based analysis pipelines and machine learning techniques.
Processed large-scale datasets on the KAGAYAKI high-performance computing cluster with PBS job scheduling, implementing automated batch workflows for reproducible research.
Developed data validation and quality assurance algorithms to ensure research data integrity and constraint compliance across multi-stage processing pipelines.
Developed an automated grading system integrating the GPT-3.5 API for 80+ students, with data processing pipelines that reduced processing time by 80%.
Built database systems and data migration scripts in Python and SQL; designed the system architecture and wrote its technical documentation.
Implemented containerisation and automated deployment workflows using Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
